purpose: Teach: 熊野/小澤/杉田/菅原/豊島/志村/川原/清原

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、熊野詣でから帰られたばかりだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer just got back from a pilgrimage to Kumano, didn't they?
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Warm recollection. Slight wonder in the phrasing, as if piecing together something gentle about someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、音楽家小澤さんのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is a fan of the composer Ozawa, apparently.
lines.style: Gentle observation, sharing. Quiet delight in learning something specific about someone. Slow, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、医者の杉田家との縁を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told us about their connection to the Sugita family — they're doctors.
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful. Noting the detail with quiet respect. Slight emphasis on 'told us,' as if honoring the trust of the telling.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、天神様、つまり菅原道真のお守りを持ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was carrying a charm of Tenjin — Sugawara Michizane — wasn't it?
lines.style: Noticing aloud, almost tenderly. Light curiosity about this small sacred thing. Phrased as a confirmation more than a question.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東京の豊島区にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer lives in Toshima Ward, in Tokyo.
lines.style: Simple statement, held gently. Like placing a fact down with care. No urgency, just... noting.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コメディアン志村けんを尊敬されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really admires the comedian Shoji Ken.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Light surprise at the detail. Said with genuine interest in this person's quiet taste.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様のお名前が川原くんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, their grandchild's name is Kawahara, wasn't it?
lines.style: Soft confirmation, almost affectionate. The name said with care, like it matters that she got it right.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、清原家のお祝いに行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is going to a celebration at the Kiyohara family's place.
lines.style: Final detail, settling into place. Satisfied and warm. Slight trailing-off, like completing a small portrait of someone we've grown to know through pieces.
